title: Out-of-bounds channel index when n_channels < 3
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs
Line: 103

synchronized_hop_channel clamps n_channels to minimum 3 via .max(3), then computes 1 + (h % (n-1)). When n_channels=2, this returns 1 or 2, but channel 2 does not exist (valid indices: 0,1). When n_channels=1, returns 1 or 2, but only channel 0 exists. Callers indexing into a channel array will panic.
close_reason: Already fixed: current code uses 'if n_channels < 2 { return 0; }' guard instead of .max(3) clamp, tests verify correct edge case handling
